changelog: Queued episodes can no longer reuse an existing queue id, which used to make one removal drop two entries.
The play queue, the equalizer presets and the shared option catalogue are now covered by contract tests.
A regression test that fails without the queue-id fix proves the new coverage is real.
Option tables must keep their labels and value mappings in step, so no picker can store an unmappable value.
message: Play queue id integrity and option catalogue contract tests
